# IPL 2026: Tournament summary

## Season and format

The 19th IPL ran from **March 28 to May 31, 2026**. The BCCI announced the first 20 league matches for March 28–April 12, then scheduled the remaining 50 league matches for April 13–May 24; four playoff matches followed. [1](https://www.iplt20.com/news/article/bcci-announces-schedule-for-first-phase-of-tata-ipl-2026#:~:text=IPL%20MEDIA%20ADVISORY,in%20Mumbai%20on%20Sunday) [2](https://www.iplt20.com/news/article/bcci-announces-schedule-for-second-phase-of-tata-ipl-2026#:~:text=IPL%20MEDIA%20ADVISORY,of%20the%20league%20stage) [3](https://www.iplt20.com/news/article/schedule-for-tata-ipl-2026-playoffs-announced-ahmedabad-to-host-grand-finale#:~:text=IPL%20MEDIA%20ADVISORY,for%20a%20spectacular%20finale)

The 10 teams played **14 league matches each** across two groups: each team played its four group-mates once and the five teams in the other group twice. The top four advanced to the playoffs. The top two met in Qualifier 1, with the winner going straight to the final; the third- and fourth-placed teams met in the Eliminator, whose winner played the Qualifier 1 loser in Qualifier 2 for the other final place. [4](https://www.rajasthanroyals.com/latest-news/ipl-2026-format-indian-premier-league-cricket-new#:~:text=The%20seedings%20are%20based,and%20LSG%20twice%20each) [5](https://www.rajasthanroyals.com/latest-news/ipl-2026-format-indian-premier-league-cricket-new#:~:text=The%20system%20has%20changed,same%20as%20last%20year) [6](https://www.rajasthanroyals.com/latest-news/ipl-2026-format-indian-premier-league-cricket-new#:~:text=Finishing%20in%20the%20top,more)

## Champion and final

**Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) won the title**, defeating Gujarat Titans (GT) by five wickets in Ahmedabad on May 31. GT made **155/8**; RCB reached **161/5 in 18 overs**, with 12 balls to spare. Virat Kohli was named Player of the Match for his unbeaten **75 off 42 balls**. RCB’s win defended its crown and made the franchise only the third, after Chennai Super Kings and Mumbai Indians, to retain an IPL title. [7](https://www.iplt20.com/news/article/tata-ipl-2026-final-rcb-v-gt-match-report#:~:text=Royal%20Challengers%20Bengaluru%20%28RCB,View%20X%20post) [8](https://www.cricinfo.com/series/ipl-2026-1510719/royal-challengers-bengaluru-vs-gujarat-titans-final-1535465/full-scorecard#:~:text=Royal%20Challengers%20Bengaluru,with%2012%20balls%20remaining) [9](https://www.cricinfo.com/series/ipl-2026-1510719/royal-challengers-bengaluru-vs-gujarat-titans-final-1535465/full-scorecard#:~:text=Player%20Of%20The%20Match,75%2A%20%2842)

## Playoffs

- **Qualifier 1, May 26:** RCB made **254/5** and beat GT, who were all out for **162**, by 92 runs. RCB captain Rajat Patidar was Player of the Match for **93 not out off 33 balls**. [10](https://www.cricinfo.com/series/ipl-2026-1510719/royal-challengers-bengaluru-vs-gujarat-titans-qualifier-1-1535462/full-scorecard#:~:text=Royal%20Challengers%20Bengaluru,254%2F5) [11](https://www.cricinfo.com/series/ipl-2026-1510719/royal-challengers-bengaluru-vs-gujarat-titans-qualifier-1-1535462/full-scorecard#:~:text=Gujarat%20Titans,won%20by%2092%20runs) [12](https://www.cricinfo.com/series/ipl-2026-1510719/royal-challengers-bengaluru-vs-gujarat-titans-qualifier-1-1535462/full-scorecard#:~:text=Player%20Of%20The%20Match,93%2A%20%2833)
- **Eliminator, May 27:** Rajasthan Royals (RR) scored **243/8** and beat Sunrisers Hyderabad (SRH), all out for **196**, by 47 runs. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi hit **97 off 29 balls**. [13](https://www.cricinfo.com/series/ipl-2026-1510719/rajasthan-royals-vs-sunrisers-hyderabad-eliminator-1535463/full-scorecard#:~:text=Rajasthan%20Royals,243%2F8) [14](https://www.cricinfo.com/series/ipl-2026-1510719/rajasthan-royals-vs-sunrisers-hyderabad-eliminator-1535463/full-scorecard#:~:text=Sunrisers%20Hyderabad,won%20by%2047%20runs) [15](https://www.cricinfo.com/series/ipl-2026-1510719/rajasthan-royals-vs-sunrisers-hyderabad-eliminator-1535463/full-scorecard#:~:text=Player%20Of%20The%20Match,97%20%2829)
- **Qualifier 2, May 29:** GT chased RR’s **214/6**, reaching **219/3** to win by seven wickets with eight balls remaining. Shubman Gill scored **104 off 53 balls**. [16](https://www.cricinfo.com/series/ipl-2026-1510719/gujarat-titans-vs-rajasthan-royals-qualifier-2-1535464/full-scorecard#:~:text=Rajasthan%20Royals,214%2F6) [17](https://www.cricinfo.com/series/ipl-2026-1510719/gujarat-titans-vs-rajasthan-royals-qualifier-2-1535464/full-scorecard#:~:text=Gujarat%20Titans,with%208%20balls%20remaining) [18](https://www.cricinfo.com/series/ipl-2026-1510719/gujarat-titans-vs-rajasthan-royals-qualifier-2-1535464/full-scorecard#:~:text=Player%20Of%20The%20Match,104%20%2853)
- **Final, May 31:** RCB completed the title-winning chase, beating GT by five wickets. [8](https://www.cricinfo.com/series/ipl-2026-1510719/royal-challengers-bengaluru-vs-gujarat-titans-final-1535465/full-scorecard#:~:text=Royal%20Challengers%20Bengaluru,with%2012%20balls%20remaining)

## Final standings and qualification
